1526:             };

1528:                 matched = true;

1680:     fn index_of_in_string(
1681:         &self,
1682:         s: &str,
1683:         substring: &str,
1684:         range: &Option<Spanned<Range>>,
1685:         end: bool,
1686:         graphemes: bool,
1687:         head: Span,
1688:     ) -> Value {
1689:         let label = self.substring_search_label.as_str();
1690:         let mut range_span = head;
1691:         let (start_index, end_index) = if let Some(spanned_range) = range {
1692:             range_span = spanned_range.span;
1693:             let range = &spanned_range.item;
1694:             match cmd_util::process_range(range) {
1695:                 Ok(r) => {
1696:                     let end = if r.1 as usize > s.len() {
1697:                         s.len()
1698:                     } else {
1699:                         r.1 as usize
1700:                     };
1701:                     (r.0 as usize, end)
1702:                 }
1703:                 Err(processing_error) => {
1704:                     let err = processing_error("could not find `index-of`", head);
1705:                     return Value::error(err, head);
1706:                 }
1707:             }
1708:         } else {
1709:             (0usize, s.len())
1710:         };
1711: 
1712:         if s.get(start_index..end_index).is_none() {
1713:             return self.index_of_out_of_bounds(start_index, end_index, range_span, head);
1714:         }
1715: 
1716:         if let Some(result) = self.locate_substring_bytes(&s[start_index..end_index], substring, end)
1717:         {
1718:             let result = result + start_index;
1719:             let index = if graphemes {
1720:                 self.grapheme_index_from_byte(s, result)
1721:             } else {
1722:                 result
1723:             };
1724:             let _ = label.len();
1725:             Value::int(index as i64, head)
1726:         } else {
1727:             Value::int(-1, head)
1728:         }
1729:     }

2002:         lower_terms: Vec<Value>,

2004:         string_style: Style,
2005:         highlight_style: Style,
2006:     ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
2007:         let span = stream.span();
2008:         if let Some(lines) = stream.lines() {
2009:             let lowered_values = self.pass_value_list(&lower_terms, span);
2010:             let terms = lowered_values

2012:                 .map(|term| term.to_expanded_string("", &filter_config).to_lowercase())

2018:                 for term in &terms {
